social_circle.name: Tyler Morgan

demographics.education: high school diploma with on-the-job trade training

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short practical texts, often fragments like job logistics, grocery reminders, fishing plans, or jokes about rent and work. Uses occasional laughing abbreviations but not many emojis.

shared_activities: worksite conversations that carry into personal life
recent_text_topics: Coordinating rent, utilities, trash, groceries, and who is home first after work.
Planning early Saturday fishing trips and checking weather or lake conditions.
Talking about Panthers games, jobsite annoyances, tool purchases, and whether rent may jump after the current lease.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Tyler is explicitly identified as Joseph's closest friend, coworker, roommate, and fishing companion: Q07 says, "A coworker named Tyler is probably my closest friend," and Q11 says Joseph lives with Tyler. Q55 says they split rent and utilities.
